```{r setup}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = TRUE, error = FALSE)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(datawizard)
library(emmeans)
library(sandwich)
library(lmtest)

analysis_dir <- "."
output_dir <- "."
figure_dir <- "figures"
analysis_data <- read.csv("complete_cleaned_data.csv")
analysis_data$group <- factor(analysis_data$group,
                              levels = c("Black", "Hispanic/Latine", "Asian"))
analysis_data$recruitment <- factor(analysis_data$recruitment,
                                    levels = c("UM panel", "UCSB SONA"))
```


```{r center-and-split}
analysis_data <- analysis_data %>% group_by(group) %>% mutate(
  lifetime_ca_c = as.numeric(datawizard::center(lifetime_ca)),
  past_year_vr_c = as.numeric(datawizard::center(past_year_vr)),
  identification_c = as.numeric(datawizard::center(identification)),
  age_c = as.numeric(datawizard::center(age))
) %>% ungroup()

black_data <- analysis_data %>% filter(group == "Black")
latine_data <- analysis_data %>% filter(group == "Hispanic/Latine")
asian_data <- analysis_data %>% filter(group == "Asian")
group_data <- list(Black = black_data, `Hispanic/Latine` = latine_data, Asian = asian_data)
```

```{r reporting}
hc3_table <- function(model) {
  covariance <- sandwich::vcovHC(model, type = "HC3")
  tests <- lmtest::coeftest(model, vcov. = covariance, df = df.residual(model))
  critical_t <- qt(.975, df = df.residual(model))
  data.frame(
    term = rownames(tests), B = tests[, 1], SE_HC3 = tests[, 2],
    t = tests[, 3], df = df.residual(model), p = tests[, 4],
    CI_low = tests[, 1] - critical_t * tests[, 2],
    CI_high = tests[, 1] + critical_t * tests[, 2],
    n = nobs(model), R2 = summary(model)$r.squared,
    adjusted_R2 = summary(model)$adj.r.squared, row.names = NULL
  )
}

collect_coefficients <- function(fits, model_name) {
  bind_rows(lapply(names(fits), function(group_name) {
    hc3_table(fits[[group_name]]) %>%
      mutate(model = model_name, group = group_name, .before = 1)
  }))
}

focal_results <- function(coefficients, focal_term) {
  coefficients %>% filter(term == focal_term) %>%
    mutate(p_Holm_three = p.adjust(p, method = "holm"))
}
```

# Main analyses


## Model 1: lifetime engagement × VR

```{r model-1}
model1_black <- lm(future_ca ~ lifetime_ca_c * past_year_vr_c, data = black_data)
model1_latine <- lm(future_ca ~ lifetime_ca_c * past_year_vr_c, data = latine_data)
model1_asian <- lm(future_ca ~ lifetime_ca_c * past_year_vr_c, data = asian_data)

model1_fits <- list(Black = model1_black, `Hispanic/Latine` = model1_latine,
                      Asian = model1_asian)
coefficients1 <- collect_coefficients(model1_fits, "Model1")
focal1 <- focal_results(coefficients1, "lifetime_ca_c:past_year_vr_c")
knitr::kable(coefficients1 %>% select(group, term, B, SE_HC3, CI_low, CI_high, p, n, R2), digits = 4)
knitr::kable(focal1 %>% select(group, B, CI_low, CI_high, p, p_Holm_three), digits = 5)
```

### Simple VR slopes — Table S3

```{r model-1-slopes}
slopes1 <- bind_rows(lapply(names(model1_fits), function(group_name) {
  d <- group_data[[group_name]]
  m <- model1_fits[[group_name]]
  moderator_values <- list(lifetime_ca_c = c(-sd(d$lifetime_ca), 0, sd(d$lifetime_ca)))
  slopes <- emmeans::emtrends(
    m, specs = ~ lifetime_ca_c, var = "past_year_vr_c",
    at = moderator_values, vcov. = sandwich::vcovHC(m, type = "HC3"), df = df.residual(m)
  )
  as.data.frame(summary(slopes, infer = c(TRUE, TRUE), adjust = "none")) %>%
    mutate(group = group_name, model = "Model1", .before = 1)
}))
knitr::kable(slopes1, digits = 4)
```

## Model 2: lifetime engagement × VR × identification

```{r model-2}
model2_black <- lm(future_ca ~ lifetime_ca_c * past_year_vr_c * identification_c,
                   data = black_data)
model2_latine <- lm(future_ca ~ lifetime_ca_c * past_year_vr_c * identification_c,
                    data = latine_data)
model2_asian <- lm(future_ca ~ lifetime_ca_c * past_year_vr_c * identification_c,
                   data = asian_data)

model2_fits <- list(Black = model2_black, `Hispanic/Latine` = model2_latine,
                      Asian = model2_asian)
coefficients2 <- collect_coefficients(model2_fits, "Model2")
focal2 <- focal_results(coefficients2, "lifetime_ca_c:past_year_vr_c:identification_c")
knitr::kable(coefficients2 %>% select(group, term, B, SE_HC3, CI_low, CI_high, p, n, R2), digits = 4)
knitr::kable(focal2 %>% select(group, B, CI_low, CI_high, p, p_Holm_three), digits = 5)
```

### Simple VR slopes — Tables S4–S6

```{r model-2-slopes}
slopes2 <- bind_rows(lapply(names(model2_fits), function(group_name) {
  d <- group_data[[group_name]]
  m <- model2_fits[[group_name]]
  moderator_values <- list(lifetime_ca_c = c(-sd(d$lifetime_ca), 0, sd(d$lifetime_ca)))
  moderator_values$identification_c <- c(-sd(d$identification), 0, sd(d$identification))
  slopes <- emmeans::emtrends(
    m, specs = ~ lifetime_ca_c * identification_c, var = "past_year_vr_c",
    at = moderator_values, vcov. = sandwich::vcovHC(m, type = "HC3"), df = df.residual(m)
  )
  as.data.frame(summary(slopes, infer = c(TRUE, TRUE), adjust = "none")) %>%
    mutate(group = group_name, model = "Model2", .before = 1)
}))
knitr::kable(slopes2, digits = 4)
```

```{r model-list}
models <- list(Model1 = model1_fits, Model2 = model2_fits)
```

# Supplementary analyses

## Age, gender, and recruitment — Table S7


```{r gender-covariate}
analysis_data <- analysis_data %>% mutate(
  gender_covariate = case_when(
    gender %in% c("Male", "Transgender male") ~ "Men",
    gender %in% c("Female", "Transgender female") ~ "Women",
    gender %in% c("Non-binary", "Genderqueer", "Genderfluid") ~ "Gender diverse",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  ),
  gender_covariate = factor(gender_covariate, levels = c("Women", "Men", "Gender diverse"))
)
```

```{r supplement-formulas}
model1_formula <- future_ca ~ lifetime_ca_c * past_year_vr_c
model2_formula <- future_ca ~ lifetime_ca_c * past_year_vr_c * identification_c
base_formulas <- list(Model1 = model1_formula, Model2 = model2_formula)
```

```{r matched-adjustment}
fit_adjustment_check <- function(data, covariates, check_name, sample_name) {
  bind_rows(lapply(names(base_formulas), function(model_name) {
    original_formula <- base_formulas[[model_name]]
    required <- unique(c(all.vars(original_formula), covariates))
    d <- as.data.frame(data[complete.cases(data[, required]), , drop = FALSE])
    d <- droplevels(d)
    adjusted_formula <- update(original_formula,
                               paste(". ~ . +", paste(covariates, collapse = " + ")))
    unadjusted <- lm(original_formula, data = d, na.action = na.fail)
    adjusted <- lm(adjusted_formula, data = d, na.action = na.fail)
    bind_rows(
      hc3_table(unadjusted) %>% mutate(version = "Unadjusted on matched sample"),
      hc3_table(adjusted) %>% mutate(version = "Adjusted")
    ) %>% mutate(check = check_name, group = sample_name, model = model_name, .before = 1)
  }))
}
```

```{r age-gender}
covariate_data <- analysis_data %>%
  filter(!(group == "Black" & gender_covariate == "Gender diverse"))
demographic_checks <- bind_rows(lapply(levels(analysis_data$group), function(group_name) {
  d <- filter(covariate_data, group == group_name)
  fit_adjustment_check(d, c("age_c", "gender_covariate"), "Age and gender", group_name)
}))
```

```{r source-adjustment}
source_checks <- bind_rows(lapply(c("Black", "Hispanic/Latine"), function(group_name) {
  fit_adjustment_check(filter(covariate_data, group == group_name),
                        c("age_c", "gender_covariate", "recruitment"),
                        "Age gender and recruitment", group_name)
}))
supplementary_coefficients <- bind_rows(demographic_checks, source_checks)

supplement_focal <- supplementary_coefficients %>% filter(
  (model == "Model1" & term == "lifetime_ca_c:past_year_vr_c") |
    (model == "Model2" & term == "lifetime_ca_c:past_year_vr_c:identification_c")
)

knitr::kable(supplement_focal %>% select(check, group, model, version, B, CI_low, CI_high, p, n), digits = 4)
```

## Pooled group adjustment — Table S8


```{r pooled-group}
pooled_data <- analysis_data %>% mutate(
  lifetime_ca_pool_c = as.numeric(datawizard::center(lifetime_ca)),
  past_year_vr_pool_c = as.numeric(datawizard::center(past_year_vr)),
  identification_pool_c = as.numeric(datawizard::center(identification)),
  age_pool_c = as.numeric(datawizard::center(age))
)
pooled1 <- lm(future_ca ~ lifetime_ca_pool_c * past_year_vr_pool_c + group, data = pooled_data)
pooled2 <- lm(future_ca ~ lifetime_ca_pool_c * past_year_vr_pool_c * identification_pool_c + group,
               data = pooled_data)
pooled_results <- bind_rows(
  hc3_table(pooled1) %>% mutate(model = "Model1", version = "Group adjusted", .before = 1),
  hc3_table(pooled2) %>% mutate(model = "Model2", version = "Group adjusted", .before = 1)
)
```

```{r pooled-adjusted}
pooled_complete <- pooled_data %>% filter(complete.cases(
  future_ca, lifetime_ca_pool_c, past_year_vr_pool_c, identification_pool_c,
  group, age_pool_c, gender_covariate, recruitment
))
pooled1_matched <- lm(formula(pooled1), data = pooled_complete)
pooled2_matched <- lm(formula(pooled2), data = pooled_complete)
pooled1_adjusted <- update(pooled1_matched, . ~ . + age_pool_c + gender_covariate + recruitment)
pooled2_adjusted <- update(pooled2_matched, . ~ . + age_pool_c + gender_covariate + recruitment)
pooled_results <- bind_rows(pooled_results,
  hc3_table(pooled1_matched) %>% mutate(model = "Model1", version = "Group adjusted on matched sample", .before = 1),
  hc3_table(pooled2_matched) %>% mutate(model = "Model2", version = "Group adjusted on matched sample", .before = 1),
  hc3_table(pooled1_adjusted) %>% mutate(model = "Model1", version = "Group age gender and source adjusted", .before = 1),
  hc3_table(pooled2_adjusted) %>% mutate(model = "Model2", version = "Group age gender and source adjusted", .before = 1)
)

pooled_focal <- pooled_results %>% filter(
  (model == "Model1" & term == "lifetime_ca_pool_c:past_year_vr_pool_c") |
    (model == "Model2" & term == "lifetime_ca_pool_c:past_year_vr_pool_c:identification_pool_c")
)
knitr::kable(pooled_focal %>% select(model, version, B, CI_low, CI_high, p, n), digits = 4)
```
